status: PROPOSAL / COUPON ONLY - not production-approved. The approved baseline is still the symmetric cross.

convention.view: Looking DOWN onto the instrument from above (the player's view with the cover removed). A sheet lying face-up under the instrument is drawn in this SAME view.
convention.mirror: NO mirror for a face-up sheet. If anything is drawn from the underside of the plate, x must be negated.
convention.bearing: clockwise from +Y (12 o'clock). x = r*sin(bearing), y = r*cos(bearing)

reading_order: Start at the double notch (12 o'clock) and sweep CLOCKWISE; the first hole met reads R, then I, F, T.

sighting_hole.note: sits over the sheet's centre mark; no solution letter may be placed under it

aperture_floor.face_to_sheet: flush (0 mm gap): the back face of the plate and the floor are the same plane
aperture_floor.material: black (AMS) in the floor, brass elsewhere; brass-only is acceptable for a contrast comparison
aperture_floor.print: back face down on the bed; outer brim only, no brim inside the holes; separate bodies, not the paint tool

notches_on_rim.shape: 1.8 x 1.8 mm square turned 45 deg (a V about 1.27 deep, 2.55 wide)
notches_on_rim.double: two notches either side of 12 o'clock, 6 deg apart centred on +Y (CAD angles 87 and 93 deg)

plate_locating_pin.note: at 3 o'clock; the plate fits one way

plate_screws.type: M3 x 8 socket head, 2.5 mm hex key

warning_to_Work: Do NOT approximate, mirror, scale, rotate or reorder these coordinates without explicit engineering approval. The sheet's letters must sit at these centres; the sheet is printed at 100 %.
